name: variable-resistor
description: A resistive element with two terminals and a complete diagonal adjustment arrow.
useCase: Show an adjustable resistance in a circuit editor.
misuse: Use accompanying text for the component value and circuit connection.

16.reason: The full diagonal shaft crosses the resistive element; a rounded solid head remains clear of the body without a cramped inner outline.

24.reason: The full two-terminal topology, diagonal shaft and solid arrowhead retain clear open space.
